text_block_list.text:
One day, visiting a site with Casino Drive
as part of research for the "Synergy PJ"—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
So delicious……!
Kyoto's pickled vegetables truly never disappoint.
choice_data_list: As expected of a tourist spot, they have plenty of souvenirs.
As expected of a tourist spot, they have plenty of souvenirs.

text_block_list.text:
Kyoto, the quintessential school trip destination.
Here, I should be able to gain plenty of insights into how the team can enjoy themselves.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm here, I ought to buy some pickles.
Being in Kyoto, perhaps turnip, or maybe shibazuke...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is to give to Acute-san.
She often shares pickled vegetables with me, so it's a return gift.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This hairpin is for Falco.
And these socks... look like they'd suit Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This jar has... konpeito candies!
Hehe, I wonder if Espoir will like them.
choice_data_list: (She really is a student of the academy after all, huh.)

text_block_list.text: Afterward, Casino Drive told me, "There's a place you can only find in Kyoto," and brought me toâ

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the finish line! Setting the pace from the front, she claims a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――So powerful!
To see such a run in the Junior Class……!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was an amazing race!
Yeah, we got to see a great race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent run she gave us!
I can't wait to see what this promising newcomer will do next!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, it just brings back memories.
Actually, my debut was in Kyoto as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's pulled far away from the chasing pack!
Casino Drive crosses the finish line in a crushing blowout victory!

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter
text_block_list.text: Leading from the break and finishing far ahead in first place! A magnificent race, but what is your next goal?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! For the next stage,
I'll aim even higher. That is to say――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――An expedition to America!
I have a vision of shining on the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
T-To America this early?!
Incredible, what an adventurous spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, our eyes are fixed on the world from this moment on... and we will triumph!
We will seize this big dream without fail!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Gaining confidence from that debut race,
they immediately flew out of Japan—
(WAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Afterward, she clinched an easy victory in her graded race challenge in America.
By all accounts, everything was proceeding flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was brimming with hope for the future.
I was confident I could overcome any hardship.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Until that race began, that is.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Why?! I was supposed to have the lead...!
Damn it, damn it aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Move, move, legs of mine...! Why won't you... damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Was it for a future like this that I ran...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Well, shall we head back soon?
I need to compile the Kyoto investigation into a report, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: The past cannot be changed—but right now, I have a mission to make this project a success.

She has overcome the crushing heartbreak beyond her dreams……
and is sprinting forward onto a brand-new path.
choice_data_list: ...How do you manage to keep moving forward?
...How do you manage to keep moving forward?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Because I cannot give up.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: When I despaired over my powerlessness, I remembered: the brilliant beacon I had been watching all along.

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text: You can become the world's number one Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't let go of the vision of myself living up to my aspiration.
In that case――I have no choice but to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Even if the environment changes, even if the means change.
The only thing I could never do was stop reaching out.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If I can't reach it on my own, then what must I do?
...I just couldn't give up on the path to my dream.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if there is light beyond that wall――
I want to reach out and grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No... it is sheer tenacity.
Even I must admit, I am stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Setbacks do not mean the end of a dream.
It is on the other side of overcoming them that I wish to shine.

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Um, excuse me over there!
Could you perhaps be Casino Drive?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—! You... could you be
the one from my debut—

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Not since we spoke at the press conference.
Actually, I've been cheering for you ever since!

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter
text_block_list.text: I hear she's taking on the world even now. Seeing her off on that journey right here in Japan fills me with pride.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Japan is where my dream first started running.
I promise to show you the moment we conquer the world!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you really are so cool!
Yeah, you really are so cool!
You really care deeply about Japan.
You really care deeply about Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Japan is where my dream first started running.
I promise to show you the moment we conquer the world!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you really are so cool!
Yeah, you really are so cool!
You really care deeply about Japan.
You really care deeply about Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —! Trainer, doing something like that in public...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't flatter me so much.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I was born in America, but……
Japan is my second home.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To take on the world from Japan and triumph.
Together with this nation…… we will make our dream come true!
